newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine working on first Eurobond issue- c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine working on first Eurobond issue- c.bank.

text.p: Ukraine is working on its first Eurobond issue which has been promised for this year, central bank chief said on Tuesday. He did not provide any details.
"Today I cannot name Ukraine's possible rating, who will lead the issue, its volume, or the market," National Bank of Ukraine Chairman Viktor Yushchenko told a news conference.
"But I do know the rating, the volume, and the market," he added.
"I can say that there is lots of activity in this area, the National Bank of Ukraine is part of the process, and the process is under control."
Last year the government announced it planned to issue Eurobonds by the end of the first quarter of 1997, totalling $250 million, and that it was reviewing a list of companies to act as agents.
